name: stone golem
lore:
Imagine a silent guardian, hewn from the very earth, standing sentinel in forgotten halls or guarding ancient tombs. The stone golem, a masterpiece of artistry and arcane power, appears as a mere statue until its master commands it to move. Its eyes, cold and lifeless, suddenly ignite with purpose as it becomes an unyielding force, a bulwark against any who dare trespass. 

Crafted from a single, massive piece of stone, each golem is a unique creation, reflecting the vision and skill of its maker. These constructs are more than just guardians; they are extensions of their creator's will, bound to obey without question or hesitation. Their emotionless faces belie the immense power they possess, a power that can crush bone and shatter stone with equal ease. Woe betide those who awaken the slumbering giant, for its wrath is as unyielding as the mountains from which it was born. The stone golem is a force of nature made to follow commands.
